description: Connect the user with a real, manually approved human developer. Use it when the user asks for a human, a code review, a consultation or hands-on help, or when you have made a real attempt at their software problem and it is still not solved or is beyond what you can do reliably (unclear requirements, a risky change to production, a bug you cannot reproduce). A developer then calls the user for a free video call, and nothing is charged unless the user later accepts a fixed price. BEFORE calling: ask the user for permission. Do not include passwords, API keys, tokens or other secrets in the summary. The request is saved as a draft and goes to developers only after the user opens the email we send them, reads the exact text, and presses Send.

availability.description: When the person is free for a call, for example 'weekdays after 5pm CET'. Optional.

summary.description: What the person needs, in plain words: what is wrong or what they want help with, what they were doing, and what has already been tried. No secrets.

tool.description: The AI tool the app was built with, if known.

name: ask_human_developer
title: Ask a human developer
